issues: src/screens/PolicyScreen.tsx: The custom checkbox Pressable component only sets `accessibilityState={{ checked }}` and `accessibilityRole="checkbox"` but does not provide the required `aria-checked` attribute. This causes the static accessibility check to fail (missing required ARIA attribute) and the UI primary flow test cannot detect a state change when the checkbox is clicked. Add `aria-checked={checked}` to the Pressable’s props (on the line where `<Pressable` is defined).
feedback: Add the missing `aria-checked` attribute to the Pressable in PolicyScreen so the element is a fully accessible checkbox. This will resolve the critical accessibility errors and allow the UI flow test to recognize the checkbox state change, making all static validation checks pass.
